source_truth: OpenStreetMap UK freight yard, container terminal, loading dock, and logistics tags via Overpass API
geometry_truth: Overpass JSON node coordinates and way/relation centers filtered through the UK carrier scope

sources.filter_rule: Keep UK railway yards, railway container terminals, freight rail landuse, industrial=logistics, and loading_dock elements; builder converts nodes/centers to point hubs and clips to the UK carrier.
sources.notes: This first UK logistics slice is a compact freight-facility point layer; it complements existing airport and port packs without publishing a country-sized OSM extract.
